title: Orchard and Ledger
author: Felix Coldharbour
blurb: Cyrus Halloran, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
